channel.title: The Brine Blog | DILL'D
channel.description: Science, flavour guides and drop news from DILL'D pickle energy drink.

item.title: How much caffeine is in a can of DILL'D?
item.description: Every 355ml can of DILL'D pickle energy drink has 180mg of caffeine, the maximum Health Canada allows per can. Here's what that means for you.

item.title: Every DILL'D flavour, ranked from mild to unhinged
item.description: Classic Dill, Sweet Heat, Sour Blast and Dill Candy: a no-nonsense guide to every DILL'D pickle energy drink flavour and which one to try first.

item.title: How the Monthly Mystery Can Drop works (and how to never miss one)
item.description: One secret DILL'D flavour every 30 days, limited cases, never restocked. Here's how the Mystery Can Drop works and how VIPs get in first.

item.title: The #DillDChallenge: inside TikTok's sourest dare
item.description: Try to finish a can of DILL'D Sour Blast without making a face. Here's where the #DillDChallenge came from, the best reactions and how to do it safely.

item.title: Does pickle juice help muscle cramps? What the science actually says
item.description: Athletes swear by pickle juice for cramps. We looked at the research on why it might work, how fast, and what that means for a pickle energy drink.
